details.description: DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Base-v1.5 is DeepSeek AI's second-generation base code model, produced by continuing to pre-train DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Base on 2 trillion tokens of code, math and natural-language data with a 4K-token context window and a next-token-prediction objective (no fill-in-the-middle). Compared with the original DeepSeek-Coder-Base 6.7B, DeepSeek's technical report shows a slight drop in HumanEval/MBPP coding scores but marked gains in math reasoning and general natural-language benchmarks. DeepSeek's current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model.
advantages: Scores 62.4% on GSM8K and 24.7% on MATH, up from 43.2% and 19.2% respectively for the original DeepSeek-Coder-Base 6.7B, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Scores 49.1% on MMLU, up from 36.6% for DeepSeek-Coder-Base 6.7B, per DeepSeek's technical report, reflecting stronger general natural-language ability.
Built by continuing pre-training from the general-purpose DeepSeek-LLM-7B-Base checkpoint, adding math- and natural-language-heavy data on top of code, per DeepSeek's technical report.
disadvantages: A base model, not instruction-tuned, so it is built for code completion rather than chat-style dialogue.
Coding scores dip slightly versus the original 6.7B base: 43.2% vs. 44.7% on multilingual HumanEval and 60.4% vs. 60.6% on MBPP, per DeepSeek's technical report.
Uses only a 4K-token context window, narrower than the original DeepSeek-Coder-Base 6.7B's 16K window, per DeepSeek's technical report.
DeepSeek's own current API no longer lists any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model; available only as open weights or via third-party hosts such as Fireworks.
use_cases: Base model for further fine-tuning (e.g. DeepSeek-Coder-Instruct-v1.5)

sources.title: DeepSeek-Coder: When the Large Language Model Meets Programming -- The Rise of Code Intelligence
DeepSeek Coder 7B Base v1.5 - Fireworks AI

notes: Catalog's 4096 max input/output tokens match both DeepSeek's paper (4K training window, Section 5) and Fireworks' listed context. DeepSeek's current API pricing page (checked 2026-09-24) no longer lists this or any DeepSeek-Coder v1 model.
